arguments.query: select name, sql from sqlite_master where type="table"

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents a,b.client_reference cr,(select group_concat(c.state||c.amount_cents||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select status||attempts from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) o from bookings b
select event_id,booking_id,payload,status,attempts from outbox where status!="delivered" limit 12

select b.booking_id,b.status s,(select group_concat(c.state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) o,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where (s="confirmed" and (k=0 or o is null or h=0 or ch not in ("captured"))) or (s="cancelled" and (k>0 or h>0))
